description: Help Scout provides an HTTPS‑only API that uses OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code and Client Credentials flows for authentication.

evidence.claim: Help Scout API uses OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code and Client Credentials flows for authentication.

evidence.notes: Create OAuth2 app via Your Profile > My apps.
Page states 'This is an HTTPS-only API'.
